crossRefs.note: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

parallels.note: “ ‘These you may eat of all that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the…
All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures…
Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.

translations.web: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.
translations.bsb: but you may not eat anything that does not have fins and scales; it is unclean for you.
translations.kjv: And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean
translations.asv: and whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye shall not eat; it is unclean unto you.
